verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a pull request workflow, though mostly through Copilot features. Copilot cloud agent makes changes on a branch so you can "review the diff, iterate, and create a pull request", and it can resolve merge conflicts. Reviews can be assigned to Copilot, which leaves feedback and suggested changes you can apply. The GitHub MCP server also works with pull requests, and forking is documented. missing for 10: first-party docs on the core human PR flow (opening, threaded discussion and comments, approvals, merge methods), explicit evidence of the merge step itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
